🧭 What this is

The Beholder's Gazette already runs a free 5e Toolkit for Dungeons & Dragons. This is its Pathfinder twin: tools built for the Pathfinder Second Edition Remaster rules, on their own pages, so neither system gets in the other's way. It's free, with no accounts and no paywall, and everything you make stays in your own browser.

We're building it now. Some tools already work with any system and are ready below. The rest are being rebuilt with Pathfinder's math and will show up here one by one.

✅ Ready to use

These tools run on Pathfinder's rules: skills and saves in place of 5e checks, cleric domains, ancestries, and no alignment. What you save on them is kept apart from the D&D tools, so the two campaigns never mix.

👹 Encounter Builder1,200 creatures from Monster Core and NPC Core. Build a fight or roll one, Trivial to Extreme. ⚔️ Initiative TrackerTurn order, HP, conditions with values like frightened 2, dying and wounded, and a player view. 🐉 BestiaryEvery creature in Monster Core, Monster Core 2, and NPC Core, by level, with its full stat block. 📖 SpellsAll 669 core spells, cantrips to rank 10, focus spells and rituals, with their full text. 💎 Loot GeneratorTreasure by party level from GM Core's table: coins, gems, art, and 1,200 core items, with a lock and trap on the chest. 🏪 Shop Generator30 kinds of shop stocked from the core books by item level, a keeper with a secret, and a Diplomacy haggle. ⚖️ Market ExchangeLive prices for 1,300 core goods, by item level, moving every 15 minutes. 👥 Party TrackerEnter the party once: the encounter and initiative tools start from it. 📓 Campaign NotebookKeep your rolls and notes, log sessions, and track quests. 📅 CalendarMonths, moons, and a festival every month, with Pathfinder skill checks. ⛪ DeitiesA pantheon of your own: domains, edicts, anathema, and feuds. 🏛️ FactionsGuilds, cults, and noble houses with goals and rivals. 🎭 NPCsNames, looks, secrets, and quest hooks for every ancestry. Stat blocks come later. 🏘️ SettlementsVillages to cities, with rulers, people, laws, and trouble. 📜 World HistoryAges, wars, and fallen empires for your setting. 🌳 Family TreesDynasties and bloodlines, generations deep. 🌍 Continent MapsA whole continent with nations and coats of arms. 🗺️ Your MapsUpload your own map and pin the places that matter. 🕸️ Relationship WebYour notebook drawn as a web of who's tied to whom. 🏷️ Tavern & Shop NamesTen names at a time for 30 kinds of place. 🎲 Dice RollerAny formula, with fortune and misfortune on the d20. 🗂️ Random TablesBuild your own tables and roll on them. ⏳ Progress ClocksTrack rituals, infiltrations, and looming threats. 📜 HandoutsWanted posters, letters, bounty boards, price lists. 🧭 Battlemap BuilderDraw a 5-foot-grid map and run it at the table.

The last two are shared with the 5e Toolkit: they have no rules in them, so they work the same at a Pathfinder table.
